title: Skepi Creole Dutch
description: Extinct Dutch Creole once spoken in Guyana
extract: Skepi is an extinct Dutch-based creole language of Guyana, spoken in the region of Essequibo. It was not mutually intelligible with Berbice Creole Dutch, also spoken in Guyana. This language has been classified as extinct since 1998.
